interactions.name: Static hosting
interactions.detail: Root and subpath HTML/assets return HTTP 200 with correct PNG MIME.

interactions.name: No-wallet interaction
interactions.detail: Keyboard opens four existing wallet app links; Back restores Connect wallet.

interactions.name: EIP-6963 connection
interactions.detail: Named wallet connects; address/Sepolia and adoption action are visible on the first 390px screen.

interactions.name: Adopt + cancellation
interactions.detail: Correct deployed address, selector, value, gas and explicit chainId; cancellation recovers.

interactions.name: Late chain change safeguard
interactions.detail: Changing chain during estimation prevents eth_sendTransaction.

interactions.name: Wrong network recovery
interactions.detail: Existing Switch to Sepolia control requests the correct chain.

interactions.name: Pet art integrity
interactions.detail: The fixture SVG is displayed byte-for-byte with no image filter or transform.

interactions.name: Cheer control
interactions.detail: Cheer is on the first 390px screen, reaches the wallet with correct pet ID/chain, and recovers on rejection.

interactions.name: Pending + confirmed cheer
interactions.detail: Pending disables actions; receipt refresh produces cheering decoration and disables repeated cheer.

interactions.name: Populated mobile layout
interactions.detail: Long golden-collar label and all board columns remain accessible at 320/390; table scrolls inside its box.

interactions.name: Motion preferences
interactions.detail: Mouse parallax works; reduced motion stops all animations and removes parallax.

interactions.name: Pause scene
interactions.detail: Native checkbox pauses the illustrated scene with keyboard support.

interactions.name: Disconnect
interactions.detail: Existing Disconnect clears the saved wallet and restores Connect.

interactions.name: Board art cache
interactions.detail: Unchanged pets reuse SVGs; XP, stage, mood and collar changes each reload exactly one image.

interactions.name: Status deadline + startup
interactions.detail: Contract/board load while status hangs; pending deployment notice stays hidden; status aborts after its eight-second deadline.

interactions.name: Console
interactions.detail: No console errors or uncaught script exceptions in the relayed/fixture interaction run.

limits: No transactions broadcast or real wallet signatures.
No WebKit, physical device, native zoom, or screen reader session.
External requests were relayed only in tests; no relay is shipped.
Probe contrast checks exclude gradients and artwork; see separately sampled contrast results.
